# CALTECH ALPINE CLUB ROLES. The jobs th: # Three files
and each fact is written in exactly one of them:

# CALTECH ALPINE CLUB ROLES. The jobs th: #   data/people.csv       WHO EXISTS -- names
#   data/roles.csv        WHAT THE JOBS ARE -- this file
#   data/assignments.csv  WHO IS DOING WHICH JOB
# Nobody ever types the word "vacant". A job listed here with nobody assigned to
# it in data/assignments.csv is shown as open
# by itself when somebody is added. There is no second edit to remember.
# Lines starting with # are ignored
so you can leave notes here.

# CALTECH ALPINE CLUB ROLES. The jobs th: # THE ORDER OF THE ROWS IS THE ORDER ON THE PAGE. Move a row and the site
# follows -- officers are listed in this order too. There is no sort column.
# role_id      a short permanent name for the job
#              underscores: film_festival. NOTHING SHOWS IT TO VISITORS. It is
#              what data/assignments.csv points at
#              what the website's own code looks for.
#              >>> PICK IT ONCE AND NEVER CHANGE IT. <<<
#              You can rename the TITLE below as often as you like -- to
#              Co-President
#              because no part of the site looks at the title to decide
#              anything. Changing a role_id is the one edit that does break
#              things
and `php tools/check.php` will tell you what.

# CALTECH ALPINE CLUB ROLES. The jobs th: # title        what one holder of this job is called. Change this freely.
# title_shared what EACH holder is called when more than one person shares the
#              job -- "Co-President" for two presidents. LEAVE IT BLANK and the
#              title above is used however many people there are
#              right for most jobs: two hiking coordinators are just two hiking
#              coordinators
# group        the heading it appears under.
# min_people   how many the club NEEDS. Below this the job is advertised as
#              open
on the homepage and everywhere else. Set it to 0 for a job

# CALTECH ALPINE CLUB ROLES. The jobs th: #              that is nice to have and not essential -- an empty one is then
#              offered quietly instead of announced as a gap.
# max_people   how many the club can USE. Between min and max the site says
#              there is room for another without calling the job open. LEAVE
#              BLANK for a job that takes as many volunteers as turn up
#              never asks for more once somebody is doing it.
# description  what the job involves
in a sentence or two. Write it so it is

# CALTECH ALPINE CLUB ROLES. The jobs th: #              still true in five years: no names
#              drift. What one person did last year belongs in a handover note.
# contact_for  what to write to this person about
in a few words. Shown under

# CALTECH ALPINE CLUB ROLES. The jobs th: #              their name on the About page. It describes the JOB
#              written once here however many people share it.
# recruiting   LEAVE BLANK almost always. Two other things it can say:
#                a sentence -- for a job that is filled and still needs
#                  somebody: "stepping down in June". What you write is what
#                  the site shows.
#                the word no -- stop advertising this job for now
#                  is empty. It still appears on Get Involved with its
#                  description; it just stops asking. Delete the word to start
#                  asking again.
# Retiring a job: delete the row. Nobody is lost -- the people who held it stay
